name: Claude Code
one_liner: Agentic coding in the terminal — delegated tasks rather than inline completion.
what_it_is: A terminal-based coding agent that reads and edits files, runs commands and tests, and works through multi-step tasks, alongside editor and desktop interfaces.
why_it_matters: The distinction worth understanding is delegation versus completion: rather than suggesting the next line, an agent is given a task and works through it, running commands and reading results. That is a different working relationship with different failure modes, and it is genuinely unsettled which shape wins. Listed as emerging for that reason, and disclosed plainly: this entry was drafted with the tool it describes.
suitable_for: Work where running tests and iterating is part of the loop
Developers comfortable working in a terminal
not_suitable_for: Developers who prefer inline suggestions inside the editor
Organisations that cannot send source to a third-party service
Tasks where writing the prompt costs more than writing the code
